summary: FKR v1 (Forum Knowledge Retrieval Layer) — END-TO-END HTTP TESTING: ALL GREEN. Created /app/backend/tests/test_fkr_v1_endpoints.py (10 tests, 10/10 PASS in 25.75s). The sprint-critical acceptance probe — Pete asking 'What is Thaddeus's Incarnation Cross?' via POST /api/mirror/chat — yields the LLM-generated response: "Thaddeus's Incarnation Cross is the Right Angle Cross of Sleeping Phoenix 1." with ZERO mention of 'Sphinx'. GET /api/health returns 200 healthy. Pete's MC question correctly returns Virgo (matches stored 28°Virgo). Pete×Mel relationship and comparison questions correctly name Mel and acknowledge both placements. Forum chat at /api/forums/69dd05eaa333335fcbf3ad33/chat returns 200 with content referencing forum members. FKR v1 is ready to ship.

critical_code_review_comments: FKR service (/app/backend/services/forum_chat_knowledge_retrieval.py) — pure-read implementation, no mutations, correctly extracts incarnation_cross from multiple schema variants via _ic_name(). Good defensive None-handling.
Mirror router wiring (routers/mirror_chat.py) — FKR block is appended to system_prompt AFTER the V1/lens/keystone/preference blocks and BEFORE the emergent_generate() call; ordering looks correct.
Forum router wiring (routers/forums_chat.py:347-374) — FKR block injected after forum-mirror-orchestrator V8 anchor block; ordering is correct (FKR before mode hint).
Note (non-blocking): routers/mirror_chat.py is now ~2000+ lines and would benefit from extracting the chart-context builder into a helper module for future maintainability.
